scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older bearded man in ochre and russet robes sits at a wooden table, an iron cuff and slack chain around one wrist. A blank rolled parchment and ink pot lie before him. Beyond the stone window, three robed adults walk along a sunlit path through olive trees toward distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imprisoned Paul and the walkers imaginatively unite two ideas in the verse: his confinement in the Lord and his appeal for lives worthy of their calling. The path makes the metaphor of walking visible. The room, window view and travelers are illustrative inventions, not an event or location described by this verse. His hopeful expression does not imply release from confinement.
